Realizing Near-Unity Quantum Efficiency of Zero-Dimensional Antimony Halides through Metal Halide Structural Modulation

Download record JSON ↓

Complete supplied eight-page main article and matched 26-page SI read and independently audited. Separate canonical/reader, molecular and apparatus audits passed. Two routes, one protocol variant, six supporting procedures and seven observation contexts remain distinct. Printed conflicts, missing crystal ZIP/video and unresolved physical specimen joins are preserved. No new training task or exact structure–recipe pair is admitted.

Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
characterization

Acquire PXRD and SCXRD

Acquire PXRD and SCXRD. PXRD: PANalytical B.V. x’pert3. SCXRD: Rigaku XtaLAB PRO MM007HF with Cu Kalpha at room temperature; precise crystal temperatures and refinement values are retained in S1. No numeric wavelength is supplied here. Missing fields: scan details, original ZIP.

characterization

Acquire XPS; acquire TGA under N2

Acquire XPS; acquire TGA under N2. XPS: Shimadzu Kratos AXIS SUPRA+. TGA: PerkinElmer Pyris1 under N2. No scan ramp or flow is stated. Missing fields: ramp, N2 flow.

characterization

Baseline then integrate crystal PLQE

Baseline then integrate crystal PLQE. Zolix OmniFluo with calibrated Labsphere integrating sphere; measure 365 nm baseline, then single crystals or dried nanocrystal powder. Missing fields: mass.
